questions.stem: Responsibility for the safety of navigation must be:
options: Clearly defined at all times
Shared by the whole crew
Left to whoever is at the helm
Handed to the pilot when aboard
questions.explanation: Even with the master or a pilot aboard.

questions.stem: Before taking over a watch you should know:
options: The weather forecast and the expected time of arrival
The position, course, speed, hazards and traffic
Only the course to steer and the autopilot setting
The engine hours and fuel used since the last watch

questions.stem: If a manoeuvre is in progress at handover time:
options: The handover goes ahead as scheduled
The incoming person takes over mid-turn
The outgoing person leaves on time
The handover is delayed until it is complete
questions.explanation: Don't hand over during an action.

questions.stem: Repeating back an order is useful because it:
options: Lets the helm change the order if needed
Confirms the message was understood
Replaces the need to log the order
Shows the helm outranks the officer

questions.stem: When a pilot is aboard, the master:
options: May leave the bridge for the passage
Transfers all legal duty to the pilot
Remains responsible for the vessel
Is responsible only for the crew

questions.stem: Mistakes and unclear situations should be:
options: Blamed on others
Reported promptly
Kept quiet to avoid blame
Fixed quietly by yourself
Your first impression
The GPS alone
The autopilot display
More than one source
Able to take over at once, straight from a lit cabin
Fit and alert, with eyes adjusted to the dark at night
Free to learn the vessel's equipment during the watch
Rested, though the handover briefing can be skipped

questions.stem: Tasks on a small crew should be:
options: Left until something goes wrong
Allocated so nobody is overloaded
All given to the most experienced hand
Picked up by whoever happens to be free
questions.explanation: Look-out, steering and plotting need owners.

questions.stem: Radio calls or paperwork should not:
options: Be kept accurate
Be done by the skipper
Be done in port
Replace the look-out
